title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
keyIdea: Post-order DFS. helper returns the best downward gain from a node (val + the better child gain, negatives clipped to 0). At each node the best path bending there is val + left + right; track the maximum in maxi.

approaches.name: DFS returning the one-side gain
approaches.idea: left = max(helper(left), 0), right = max(helper(right), 0); maxi = max(maxi, val + left + right); return val + max(left, right).
approaches.why: Each node is visited once; recursion depth = tree height.

quiz.q: Why does helper return val + max(left, right), not val + left + right?
options: The parent extends the path upward, and a path can only continue down one side
A negative branch lowers the sum, so don't take it at all

quiz.q: Why start maxi at INT_MIN and not 0?
options: If every value is negative, the answer is the largest single value, which is below 0

quiz.q: Where is the answer path allowed to bend?
options: At exactly one node: the highest node on the path
